description: Defines the ReportingCache class interface for managing in-memory storage of reports, clients, endpoint groups, and related operations in the reporting system. Includes methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and testing reports and endpoints, as well as persistent storage handling.

classes.name: ReportingCache
classes.description: Interface for in-memory cache of reporting reports, clients, and endpoints, with methods for managing reports and endpoint configurations.

classes.name: ReportingCache::PersistentReportingStore
classes.description: Abstract class for persistent storage of reporting reports and client configurations.

methods.name: AddReport
methods.description: Adds a report to the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetReports
methods.description: Retrieves all reports in the cache, excluding doomed reports.

methods.name: GetReportsAsValue
methods.description: Returns all reports in the cache as a base::Value, including pending and doomed.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliver
methods.description: Retrieves reports eligible for delivery and marks them as pending.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliverForSource
methods.description: Retrieves reports for a specific reporting source and marks them as pending.

methods.name: ClearReportsPending
methods.description: Unmarks reports as pending.

methods.name: IncrementReportsAttempts
methods.description: Increments the attempt count for reports.

methods.name: IncrementEndpointDeliveries
methods.description: Records delivery attempts and success for reports to an endpoint.

methods.name: SetExpiredSource
methods.description: Marks a reporting source as expired.

methods.name: GetExpiredSources
methods.description: Returns set of expired reporting sources.

methods.name: RemoveReports
methods.description: Removes specified reports, marking pending reports as doomed.

methods.name: RemoveAllReports
methods.description: Removes all reports from the cache.

methods.name: GetFullReportCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns total report count including doomed reports.

methods.name: GetReportCountWithStatusForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of reports with specific status.

methods.name: IsReportPendingForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a report is pending.

methods.name: IsReportDoomedForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a report is doomed.

methods.name: OnParsedHeader
methods.description: Adds or updates client configuration based on parsed header.

methods.name: OnParsedReportingEndpointsHeader
methods.description: Adds named endpoints from header for a reporting source.

methods.name: GetAllOrigins
methods.description: Returns all client origins in cache.

methods.name: RemoveClient
methods.description: Removes client for a specific (NIK, origin) pair.

methods.name: RemoveClientsForOrigin
methods.description: Removes all clients for a given origin.

methods.name: RemoveAllClients
methods.description: Removes all clients, groups, and endpoints.

methods.name: RemoveEndpointGroup
methods.description: Removes an endpoint group and its endpoints.

methods.name: RemoveEndpointsForUrl
methods.description: Removes all endpoints matching a URL.

methods.name: RemoveSourceAndEndpoints
methods.description: Removes a reporting source and its endpoints.

methods.name: AddClientsLoadedFromStore
methods.description: Loads endpoints and groups from persistent store.

methods.name: GetCandidateEndpointsForDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves candidate endpoints for delivery based on group key.

methods.name: GetClientsAsValue
methods.description: Returns status of clients as a base::Value.

methods.name: GetEndpointCount
methods.description: Returns total number of endpoints.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes cache to disk if applicable.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Returns all V1 endpoints keyed by origin.

methods.name: GetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: GetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint for testing.

methods.name: EndpointGroupExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint group exists with specific properties.

methods.name: ClientExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a client exists for given (NIK, origin).

methods.name: GetEndpointGroupCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns number of endpoint groups.

methods.name: GetClientCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns number of clients.

methods.name: GetReportingSourceCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns number of reporting source tokens.

methods.name: SetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets an endpoint with specific properties for testing.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: GetIsolationInfoForEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves isolation info for a given endpoint.
